parameters.query: SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS open_conversations, MAX(last_message_at) AS last_activity FROM conversations WHERE status = 'open' AND (last_message_at IS NULL OR last_message_at < now() - interval '24 hours') GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tenant_id;
